text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...! I'm so sorry.
To go and get injured like this...!
choice_data_list: Let's focus on treatment for a while.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...No, I'm totally fine!
If I just sit around doing nothing, my body will get dull!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I can't afford to stop.
To beat my rivals...
and to deliver a thrilling story to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If I don't stand back up here, I'm no protagonist!
So... please, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Now's not the time to push yourself too hard.
...All right. I'll rethink the training regimen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I think it is admirable to stand by one's convictions.
However, reckless actions can never be called effort.
choice_data_list: Because your future is what matters most.
Because your future matters more than anything else.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
choice_data_list: Once you've overcome this injury, let's move forward together again.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
Maybe I was just rushing things a bit...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'll heal my injury properly...
and make a full comeback...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
! ...Trainer...!
Yes, I will definitely see it through!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: K-Kh...! This kind of pain isn't enough to stop me...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
choice_data_list: If you do any more, it'll only get worse.
If you do any more, it'll only get worse.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki's injury grew even more severe,
and it would take quite some time to fully heal...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
choice_data_list: Yeah, this shouldn't be a problem at all!
Yeah, this looks like it won't be a problem!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, right, right?!
I'm getting plenty of good exercise!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
All right, keeping up this momentum...!
I'll show you my glorious comeback!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, without letting her body get out of shape,
Kiseki made a full recovery from her injury!
